claim: The default shards per Region quota is 20,000 in us-east-1, us-west-2 and eu-west-1; 6,000 in us-east-2, ap-northeast-1, ap-south-1, ap-southeast-1, ap-southeast-2, eu-central-1 and eu-west-3; and 1,000 in each of the other supported Regions. The quota is adjustable.
question: What is the default shard quota per account in each Region, and can it be raised?

qualifiers.condition: maximum number of shards you can create in the account in the Region; the Adjustable column says Yes
